hero.lede: An open community for developers making cool, sometimes even useful, open-source projects. Everything lives on GitHub, everyone's welcome, and yes, plenty of us like anime.
mock.name: you
story.projects.title: Open-source projects, built in the open.
story.projects.body: fuwa, a chat app you can host yourself, this very site, and whatever someone starts next. Star them, break them, send a pull request.
story.people.title: Find people to build with.
story.people.body: Devs who ship side projects, review each other's code and debug at 3am. Pick up an issue, or bring a project of your own.
story.yours.title: Make it feel like home.
story.yours.body: A profile for your featured repos, and if you're into it, a theme that restyles the whole site.
finale.title: Your spot's warm.
